problems.reason: Both sentences state that the lack of serrations on Nanotyrannus teeth is a point of debate, repeating the same claim.
Sentence 5 claims an adult specimen weighed ~704 kg, which is inconsistent with the earlier description of Nanotyrannus as a mid‑sized tyrannosauroid measuring only ~17 ft (≈5 m) long.
Sentence 10 refers to “Nanotyrannus Jane” without any prior introduction of that name or specimen, leaving the reader unclear what is meant.
Sentence 13 repeats the information that the type species is *Nanotyrannus lancensis*, which was already stated in sentence 6.
